name: Copper Fern Kitchen — New American restaurant in Portland, Oregon, United States

what_it_does.text: Copper Fern Kitchen is a New American restaurant in Portland's Pearl District, Oregon, serving dinner from a seasonal menu built on Pacific Northwest produce, plus a chef's tasting menu. Guests can eat in or order takeaway, and the menu always includes vegetarian dishes.
